terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Describe observable exterior construction and abstract service props in object space; no interior or readable map.

objectClass.primaryType: exterior-only scout lodge and north-gate patrol post
objectClass.notes: One deterministic two-streamer wind pose and abstract blank map patches replace view-variable details.

reasoning: The steep main roof and offset open lookout with mast create the multi-height silhouette.
Map table, simple weapon rack and patrol gear must remain exterior service systems under an open lean-to.
Streamer curvature, weapon count and map marks are intentionally fixed or abstracted.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The lookout and lean-to need true negative space and readable attached service geometry.

detailInventory.scanMethod: four admitted component-zone crops with hero cross-check

definitionOfDone: A floor-seated 8 by 7.6 by 6.5 yard shell reads as a north-gate scout post, keeps its open lookout and map lean-to legible and preserves the local x=0 entrance/service approach.

featureGroups.name: Steep lodge and offset lookout
qualityCriteria: Open tower, canopy and mast rise distinctly above the gable.

featureGroups.name: Exterior blank map table
qualityCriteria: Sloped table remains readable and approachable without text.

featureGroups.name: Simple weapon rack and patrol gear
qualityCriteria: Abstract spear and bow silhouettes stay attached under the lean-to.
failureModes: gear becomes detailed or loose clutter

featureGroups.name: Teal, timber, parchment, iron and amber separation
qualityCriteria: Two-bucket merge preserves service and lookout readability.

antiShallowSpecRules: Do not replace the open lookout with a solid tower block.
Keep the map and gear lean-to exterior and open.
mustNotDo: No detailed weapons or loose clutter.

assumptions: The result is a stylized game-ready approximation.
Two blank teal streamers use one fixed wind pose.
Map marks and weapons are intentionally abstract, unreadable and low-detail.

silhouette.boundingShape: low sturdy lodge under a steep teal gable with an offset open lookout and tall signal mast
silhouette.symmetry: main facade roughly centered; lookout, chimney and right lean-to strongly asymmetric

componentTree.name: Closed timber lodge and stone-piling base
componentTree.topologyRationale: The lodge body is a closed arrangement of planar timber wall bays above a damp stone and piling foundation.

localFeatures.geometryEffect: closed door aligns exactly at local x=0 and is flanked by shuttered amber windows
low masonry courses and short piles seat the lodge above damp ground

componentTree.name: Steep teal gable, dormer and chimney
componentTree.topologyRationale: A steep faceted gable is framed by oversized timber trim with a separate dormer and compact chimney.

localFeatures.geometryEffect: high teal pitch and thick timber A-frame surround a small amber dormer
compact dark-stone stack rises from the rear roof slope

componentTree.name: Raised front porch and centered approach
componentTree.topologyRationale: The porch uses rigid deck boards, short posts, rails and broad steps with visible lower gaps.

localFeatures.geometryEffect: three broad steps align at exact local x=0 and remain free of gear
short piles and spaced rails preserve visible gaps below and around deck

componentTree.name: Offset open lookout, canopy and signal mast
componentTree.topologyRationale: Four posts, an open deck, balustrade and hipped canopy create real viewing-level voids; the mast is fixed to the deck structure.

localFeatures.geometryEffect: four slim uprights and an open viewing level replace a solid tower block
short repeated balusters ring the open deck
tall central pole, horizontal crossarm and pointed cap define the highest landmark
two tapered cloth planes trail from the crossarm in a fixed non-emblem pose

componentTree.name: Open map-table service lean-to
componentTree.topologyRationale: Posts and a shallow roof protect a sloped rigid table while retaining open player-facing space.

localFeatures.geometryEffect: wide sloped timber board supports shallow blank parchment panels
table offset and lean-to posts leave a clear standing space

componentTree.name: Simple weapon rack, patrol packs and lantern
componentTree.topologyRationale: A bounded set of rigid low-detail spear, bow, pack and lantern modules is attached beneath the lean-to.

localFeatures.geometryEffect: three low-sided spear shafts and one abstract bow arc sit in a fixed timber rack
two compact box-and-roll pack silhouettes remain tied to the rack

materials.name: Merged Fenbridge opaque vertex-color material
materials.shaderModel: MeshStandardMaterial on Standard/Ultra and semantic vertex-color Lambert-compatible Low path

albedo.samplingNotes: Reference values define semantic families; map patches remain abstract and unreadable.

localOverrides.pattern: warm shallow shapes with a few abstract non-linguistic route strokes

localOverrides.region: lodge, porch, lookout and lean-to members
localOverrides.pattern: axial grain with damp lower band
flat teal semantic color with darker fold facets

albedo.samplingNotes: Shuttered windows, door lattice and one lantern only.

localOverrides.region: shuttered windows, door lattice and lean-to lantern

repetitionSystems.geometry: shafts, spearheads and one shallow bow arc

repetitionSystems.drawCallPolicy: opaque frames plus emissive pane merge

referencePbrExtraction.acceptedLimitation: studio-lit concept pixels are material-family evidence, not exact PBR recovery

screenshotReview: Compare open lookout and mast silhouette.
Check x=0 entry and map apron clearance.
Check map, gear, cloth and amber separation on Low and Ultra.

lightingFromPhoto: Neutral upper-left key reveals steep gable, lookout rail and map-table slope; exposure 1.0 with ACES tone mapping.
Soft frontal fill keeps the open tower and lean-to gear readable against dark timber.
Neutral environment rim plus floor contact shadow proves porch, lookout and lean-to depth.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Review grouped identity systems from the same comparison pair.

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: reference, render, comparison sheet and feature scores

featureReviewTargets.name: Steep lodge, open lookout, canopy, mast and streamers
Accessible local x=0 door and clear porch steps
Open viewing level, balustrade and true tower depth
Blank map table, simple weapon rack and open apron
Teal, timber, parchment, iron, cloth and amber separation
Two streamers, blank map and simple weapons remain deterministic
Exterior-only model stays within 4,000 triangles and 280 KiB

buildPasses.goal: Lock native bounds and multi-height silhouette.
acceptance: Steep gable and open mast-topped lookout match front and hero.

buildPasses.goal: Build porch, open lookout and service lean-to hierarchy.
acceptance: Lookout and lean-to remain open; x=0 approach stays clear.

buildPasses.goal: Add rail, mast, streamers, map table and simple gear.
acceptance: Every inventoried component detail has geometry.

buildPasses.goal: Apply semantic patrol colors and two-bucket response.
acceptance: Low and Ultra preserve map, cloth, gear and structure separation.

buildPasses.goal: Verify doorway, porch and map-service apron clearance.
acceptance: No attached gear blocks the x=0 entrance or map-table standing point.
At most two primitives, no interior, at most 4,000 triangles and 280 KiB.

actionReadiness.contract: Static exterior hierarchy with stable scout, map-table and entrance sockets; collision remains runtime-owned.

performanceBudget.texturePolicy: three shared external Fenbridge support maps; no embedded raster texture

proceduralStrategy: Build a closed sturdy lodge and steep roof.
Construct the lookout as posts, open deck, rails and a compact canopy rather than a solid tower.
Use fixed cloth planes, blank parchment and low-sided patrol gear.
Merge all geometry into opaque and emissive shipping buckets.
risks: Streamer direction is fixed from a view-variable wind pose.
Map details are intentionally blank and abstract.
Weapon silhouettes are simplified to protect the service read and budget.
